notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, adding {R}.
Repeat.
